新建站点固定使用 Zola 写作起点；导入模式按已有站点类型读取内容目录和 Fr: New sites always use the Zola writing starter; import mode reads the content directory and Front Matter according to the existing site type.

生成模板文件、首篇文章、部署说明和本地 Profile。: Generate template files, the first article, deployment instructions, and the local profile.
把生成的 Starter 提交并推送到远端分支。: Commit the generated starter files and push them to the remote branch.
确认 GitHub Pages / Actions 的首次部署状态。: Confirm the first GitHub Pages or Actions deployment status.
部署 Token 与仓库 Token 使用独立的钥匙串项；切换部署平台后需要保存: Deployment and repository tokens use separate Keychain entries. After switching deployment platforms, save a token for that platform. Legacy shared tokens are not reused automatically as deployment tokens and must be saved again.

变更、写入与发布、自动化和本地预览会在仓库选定后按需显示。: Changes, writing and publishing, automation, and local preview appear after a repository is selected.
仓库状态、差异、异常检查和历史会在仓库选定后按需显示；实际写入与发布统一在发布流: Repository status, differences, issue checks, and history appear after a repository is selected. Writing and publishing are performed in the unified publish flow.
